content.title: Actionable Signals in Prediction Markets: Evaluating Public and Private Information through Systematic Trading
content.abstract: Prediction markets aggregate the private beliefs of many participants into publicly observable probability estimates. Beyond prices alone, the trading behavior they generate may reveal public and private signals that are actionable for automated trading agents. We study whether these observable market signals reliably identify profitable trading opportunities.
